listen_interface.description: Network interface to listen on. Use 'auto' to let ptunnel auto-detect.

ping_dest_port.description: ICMP destination port used in the ICMP tunnel (must match between client and server). 0 = echo request.

max_tunnels.description: Maximum number of concurrent tunnels (TCP connections) allowed.

ping_ttl.description: Time-to-live (TTL) value for outgoing ICMP packets. 0 = use system default.

tunnel_timeout.description: Timeout (in seconds) after which an idle tunnel is closed.

max_idle_time.description: Maximum inactivity (in seconds) before a tunnel is forcibly closed.

verbose.description: Enable verbose logging? If true, logs at normal level. Use 0 or 1 explicitly for fine control.

log_file.description: Path to log file. Leave empty to log only to stdout/stderr.

enforce_src.description: If true, only accept ICMP packets from IPs listed in allowed_src_nets.

allowed_src_nets.description: List of allowed source networks (CIDR). Ignored unless enforce_src is true.

denied_src_nets.description: List of denied source networks (CIDR) — these are blacklisted regardless.

remote_dst.description: Target remote IP address for the ICMP tunnel (required on the receiving end).

ping_size.description: Size (in bytes) of ICMP payload. Larger sizes may improve throughput but increase fragmentation.

ping_delay.description: Delay (in milliseconds) between consecutive ping packets. Lower = more aggressive, higher = more reliable through firewalls.

run_daemon.description: Set to "true" to enable the ptunnel daemon (must be set to 'true' to start the service).

password.description: Password for securing the tunnel. Must be identical on both client and server.
